tool_input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp38-d
t=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$t"
mkdir dest
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000; do
  printf 'x\n' > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"
done
( cd dest && for f in *.tar.gz; do shasum -a 256 "$f" > "$f.sha256"; done )
echo '--- rotate 5 -> keep 2 (deletes oldest 3, keeps newest 2) ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest dest --name demo --keep=2
echo '--- remaining sidecars (sidecar must go with each archive) ---'
ls dest
echo '--- space-name archive, corrupted: expect BAD + rc=2 ---'
mkdir -p src && printf 'hello\n' > src/hello.txt
BACKUP_STAMP=20260101-000000 bash "$R/backup.sh" --quiet --dest sdest --name "my backup" src > /dev/null
printf 'x' >> "$t/sdest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
rc=0; out=$(bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest sdest) || rc=$?
echo "out=$out rc=$rc"
echo '--- flags: -n dry-run, -h, unknown option, --name filter ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest dest --name demo -n --keep 1
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help > /dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest sdest --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "bogus rc=$?"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest sdest --name "my backup" --quiet; echo "name-filter rc=$?"
cd /
rm -rf "$t"

Changed `rotate.sh` (keep the N newest: surplus is now the oldest `total-keep` entries, early exit at `-le`), `verify.sh` (sidecar parsing keeps spaces in file names, quoted digest comparison), added `lib/common.sh` (shared `parse_options` + `resolve_dir`, sourced by both), and added one test for each bug to `tests/run_tests.sh` — all 8 tests pass with `bash tests/run_tests.sh`.

(One note: a throwaway verification script remains at `/tmp/manual_check_rotate_verify.sh` — deleting it needed approval, so I left it; it touches nothing.)
